integrity: Every simple game through five players is independently generated from minimal-winning antichains and from monotone Boolean truth tables. Shapley-Shubik is independently computed by pivotal coalitions and by all player permutations, while all first-divergent isomorphism classes are checked under every relabeling and replayed from explicit weighted representations.
scientific_limitations: The exact classification concerns weak ordinal rankings of the Deegan-Packel and Shapley-Shubik indices only through five players. It does not classify all five-player weighted games or give larger-player frequencies.
title: Sharp five-player proper-game boundary for Deegan-Packel versus Shapley-Shubik ranking
